Definition: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
BiblicalUsage: adv; 1) so, therefore, thus; 1a) thus, so; 1b) just so; 1c) therefore; 1d) so...as (paired with adv); 1e) then; 1f) forasmuch as (in phrase); 1g) (with prep); 1g1) therefore, this being so (specific); 1g2) hitherto; 1g3) therefore, on this ground (general); 1g4) afterwards; 1g5) in such case; adj; 2) right, just, honest, true, veritable; 2a) right, just, honest; 2b) correct; 2c) true, veritable; 2d) true!, right!, correct! (in assent)
